scope: deployment-safe normalization confirmation on MARS physical-site folds 3 and 4
hypothesis: The protected DOFA-v2 AP gain survives when every normalization statistic is learned from fit-fold rows and applied unchanged to held rows, eliminating test-cohort adaptation.

normalization_contract.first_stage: fit raw-feature mean/std on fit-fold rows globally or per known sensor; apply unchanged to held rows
normalization_contract.second_stage: fit projected-feature mean/std on fit-fold rows globally or per known sensor; apply unchanged to held rows

selection_rule: Rank by all-gates pass, point-gate stability, paired-site AP lower bound, minimum fold AP, minimum sensor AP, pooled AP, then prefer global normalization.
interpretation: Passing authorizes a separately frozen one-shot fold-2 extraction/evaluation using fit-fold normalization only. Failure rejects the DOFA-v2 fusion as non-deployable without target-cohort adaptation.
